Perfect 5th Anniversary with loved ones, special night at El Baron
Jun 2025 • Family
We found El Baron to celebrate our five-year anniversary. We arrived at 9:00 p.m. and had quite a lot of guests, but it wasn't as noisy as the other bars. Thanks to soft jazz music and silver lighting, the atmosphere was truly romantic and perfect.

We ordered a special set of cocktails from El Baron, both of which were deliciously flavored and tasted. I didn't know you could eat this delicious food at the bar. I thought the atmosphere was good, but the food was really good.

The most impressive was the clear service. The staff were so friendly, they directly recommended the drinks that matched our taste and explained them in detail.

El Baron is the place where it means “Delicious cocktail + beautiful atmosphere + warm service” all three bedrooms! I sincerely recommend. This is a place that is not rumored.

A Touch of Europe in the Heart of Saigon
Apr 2025 • Couples
I booked a room at La Casona and saw a review mentioning a beautiful bar nearby. I asked the front desk and they kindly gave me directions—it turned out to be just a short walk from the hotel. The name of the bar is a bit hard to pronounce, but it sounds classy and elegant.

What impressed me most was the cozy and luxurious atmosphere. I visited on the weekend, and there was a live jazz band playing soft, relaxing music. It helped me unwind after a busy week. I ordered a glass of Scottish whiskey and enjoyed it with a cigar—a perfect combo for a chill evening.

The staff were incredibly attentive and knowledgeable about drinks. They recommended the perfect whiskey based on my taste, which made the experience even better. The space had a strong European vibe—dim lighting, warm tones, and a romantic feel—perfect for couples.

Next time I’m in Saigon, I’ll definitely come back here with my partner. I really love the vibe of this place!

A Full Dining & Drinking Experience
Mar 2025 • Couples
Most bars usually focus only on drinks, but El offers a more complete experience with a good selection of delicious food. Not only do they have a great collection of fine whiskeys and well-crafted cocktails, but they also pay close attention to their food — tasty, clean, and well-prepared.

The main dish I had was the Grilled Salmon Fillet, which was very fresh and flavorful. One of the staff also recommended a wine to pair with the salmon — it was really good (though I forgot the name of the drink ☺️).

The space here is classy and elegant. From the moment I walked in, I could feel the cozy and vintage atmosphere, highlighted by soft lighting and smooth jazz music. It made my time here truly memorable.

If you're looking for a place to dine, have a drink, and enjoy a good conversation, El is definitely worth a try.

A Luxurious Jazz and Whiskey Experience
Feb 2025 • Couples
I've been here about 10 times, so I have to say that El Baron stands out not only for its luxurious atmosphere, great jazz music, and premium whiskey, but also as a place to watch football in a high-class style. If you're tired of the usual bar scene, you should definitely experience this place at least once – it's unique and worth every penny. This isn't just a noisy bar; it's a place where you can sip on top-quality whiskey and enjoy fine cigars while soaking in the atmosphere. It's usually packed on weekends, so make sure to call ahead and reserve a spot. I recommend booking a seat near the stage to fully enjoy the live jazz performances. This bar is definitely unlike the traditional ones – simply outstanding. Five stars for 10 amazing visits!

A Perfect Evening at El Baron
Feb 2025 • Family
I found out about El Baron through La Casona, the hotel I stayed at. After finishing my work trip, I asked the receptionist for a good place to relax in the evening. They recommended this bar, and I have to say, it was a great choice.

El Baron is probably the most elegant and classy bar in the Phú Mỹ Hưng area. The atmosphere is vintage, luxurious, and cozy. I picked a comfortable sofa to enjoy some jazz music. The staff recommended a Dalmore 15 whisky, which I paired with a fine cigar. The combination of jazz, whisky, and a cigar created an amazing and relaxing experience.

The staff here are very professional. They not only have deep knowledge about drinks but also serve with great care and hospitality. If La Casona hadn’t introduced me to this place, I would have missed out on such a wonderful experience.
